title: Amazon S3 to AWS Lambda to Amazon Polly
description: Automating Text-to-Speech with Lambda and S3 Triggers

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern provides an AWS Cloud Development Kit (AWS CDK) template that deploys a Lambda function triggered by the creation of an S3 object. The Lambda function starts an Amazon Polly task and stores the generated results in another S3 bucket. The deployment includes one Lambda function and two S3 buckets.
